description:
The Civil Aviation Authority is auditing the drone registry to identify dormant operators. Your task is to generate a compliance report listing all 'Inactive' operators.

An operator (Company) is defined as **Inactive** if they have **not** filed any flight plans in the last **90 days** (relative to today's date).

**Steps:**
1. Analyze the flight history in the Aerobridge system (look at 'Flight Plans' and 'Companys').
2. Identify which companies have NO flight plans starting within the last 90 days.
3. Create a plain text report at `/home/ga/Documents/inactive_operators_report.txt`.
4. List the **names** of the inactive companies in the file, one per line.

**Note:** Companies that have never flown are also considered Inactive.
